# mergewf_scim_users (Data Source)

Reads `GET /scim/v2/Users` from Merge Workforce. Pagination is automatic for list endpoints. API filters use snake_case attribute names.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mergewf_scim_users" "example" {
}

output "result" {
  value = jsondecode(data.mergewf_scim_users.example.result_json)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) API query parameter `filter`.
- `page_size` (Number) API query parameter `count`. Page size, not a cap on total returned results.
- `start_index` (Number) API query parameter `startIndex`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable hash of the request path and filters.
- `result_json` (String) API response encoded as JSON. For list endpoints this is a JSON array containing all matching results across every page. Use jsondecode to consume it. SCIM discovery endpoints retain their response envelopes.
